references.text: Explains that all valuations are to be made according to the sanctuary's shekel, as mentioned in verse 3 with 'shekel by the sanctuary weight'
Describes the sanctuary's shekel as the standard for religious payments and notes that everyone from twenty years old and upward must give a gift to the Lord
Uses the same age limit of twenty years and upward for men who are able to serve in the army of Israel
Refers to the sanctuary's shekel as the standard for ransom, where one shekel equals twenty gerahs
Mentions valuation in silver according to the sanctuary's shekel for ransom
Confirms the use of the sanctuary's shekel in the census for all men from twenty years old and upward
